name: Majikina Soara
source:
The rookie queen of the SM club "Combat de Reines". She was a normal girl but has gained experience now. Her specialty is the soft whip.

Incidentally, her surname originates from Okinawa.

The patrons call her "Queen". She instinctively responds to that title.

[translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040402042916/http://www.abopa.net/~MxS/txt_char.htm]official site[/url]]
